scope: FP-DIVPRE-SLOTRES-CUT3: continue cutting T-20260902-045 sys_clk_50 setup top scalar_unit g_iter.div_pre.sig[253] -> fp_exec slot_result_r[36] (54 levels, 24.240 ns, -4.026 ns) by splitting the iterative FDIV/FSQRT round_pack itself into a two-stage IT_FIN pipeline (shift/GRS -> increment/overflow/subnormal/pack); iterative latency +1 per scalar slot, NEON 2S +2, no SDC false_path.

implementation.summary: Added fp_round_mid_t and round_pack_p1/round_pack_p2. In g_iter IT_FIN, the first cycle computes the shifted significand, guard/sticky/discarded and special bypass from div_pre/sqrt_pre and captures it in it_fin_mid_{r,lo,hi}; the second cycle completes round_increment, carry, overflow/subnormal/FZ decision and final pack before iter_done. This splits the remaining 54-level round_pack cone at the new intermediate register rather than merely moving the final result one cycle later. The T-044 leading-one predecode is retained; no new 256-bit priority scan is introduced.

semantics.raw_bit: unchanged; round_pack_p1+p2 preserve the original round_pack_h normal/tiny/special/overflow/subnormal/FZ behavior, and p2 ORs input_flags exactly as finish_pre did
semantics.commit_order: unchanged; single outstanding fp_exec transaction and one held response preserved; only fixed iterative latency increased
semantics.fpsr_fpcr: unchanged; FPCR snapshot at acceptance and FPSR sticky OR preserved
semantics.fcmp_nzcv: unchanged; CMP remains on existing pp_other path
semantics.kill_reset: unchanged; it_fin_mid_* and it_fin_valid_r are cleared on reset/kill

implementation.notes: No SDC false_path, no speculative execution, no DSP. Added 3 fp_round_mid_t registers (256-bit mantissa plus metadata) for S/D and H lane intermediates. Shared leading-one scan optimization was not implemented in this task; p1/p2 reuse the T-044 predecoded lead field.
